description: This file defines a JavaScript/TypeScript class 'JavaLanguageGenerator' that generates Java code snippets for Playwright automation scripts, supporting different modes like 'library' and 'junit'. It includes methods for generating action code, headers, footers, and formatting options, tailored for Java Playwright tests.

classes.name: JavaLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates Java code snippets for Playwright automation, supporting 'library' and 'junit' modes, with methods for generating actions, headers, footers, and formatting options.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates Java code for a given action in the context, handling different action types like click, fill, navigate, and assertions.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates Java code for specific actions based on the action type, such as close, click, hover, fill, navigate, and assertions.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates the Java code header for the test, including imports and setup code, tailored for 'junit' or standard mode.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer code for the Java test, including storage state saving if specified.
